responsibility: Implements Darwin-only GCC driver preprocessing of command-line options before invoking cc1/as/ld. Its responsibilities include validating and canonicalizing -mmacosx-version-min values, deriving a default deployment target from the host or environment, translating -arch selections into the proper -m32/-m64 mode, injecting sysroot and assembler deployment-version options, and adding Darwin driver conveniences such as default export control. This file belongs to the driver layer, not code generation, and owns Darwin command-line normalization and option synthesis.
